items.event_time_ist: Aired Wednesday morning, Oct 21 (US Eastern) — approx 3:30-6:30 PM IST Oct 21
items.summary: In a live Fox & Friends interview Wednesday morning, Zelensky said he would stop fighting immediately along the current front lines to end the war diplomatically — 'Yes, right now we have to freeze, and I think this is a real way to end this war' — calling a freeze the minimum ask of Russia, with US/European security guarantees to follow. A reversal of his stance since 2022 against any freeze (WSJ Jul 2022, ITV Feb 2025). He refused to cede Donbas: 'not fair,' saying Russia is 'not winning on the battlefield.' He also backed trilateral Zelensky-Trump-Putin talks (Europe included), called Tuesday's Oslo talks with Witkoff 'productive,' thanked Washington for restoring intel sharing, but said Starlink/Starshield remains 'still limited' — a day after WSJ reported Elon Musk ordered the slowdown; Rubio promised to work on the Starshield issue and said access decisions rest with SpaceX/Musk, not the White House.
items.title: Zelensky says he'd accept a peace deal 'freezing' the front lines — first time since 2022
